info.title: GCA - Graph Connector Agent
info.description: No-auth custom connector for the Graph Connector Agent. Exposes four read-only research operations: list Graph API operations, generate a custom connector Swagger, get session endpoints, and get session context. The server reads public Microsoft Graph CSDL metadata and requires no authentication. Deploy, namecheck, and environment operations use the separate authenticated GCA Deploy Pipeline connector.

get.description: List available HTTP operations for a Microsoft Graph API endpoint path. Returns a structured array of operations suitable for populating a dynamic selection card.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: Microsoft Graph API endpoint path(s). Supports comma-separated values for multi-endpoint queries (e.g. '/users,/groups,/deviceManagement/managedDevices').

200.description: Structured list of available Graph API operations.

post.description: Generate a Power Platform-compatible Swagger 2.0 custom connector schema from selected Microsoft Graph API operations. Returns connector name, operation count, and Gist URL.

operationIds.description: Comma-separated list of operation IDs to include (e.g. 'users.list,users.create,users.get')

baseName.description: Validated connector display name. Used as-is — no suffix is appended. If a naming prefix is configured server-side, it is applied before namecheck validation.

200.description: Generated connector details including Gist URL.

swaggerRawUrl.description: Direct raw content URL for the generated swagger JSON file. Use this URL (not gistUrl) when passing to the deploy pipeline.

get.description: Returns the list of Microsoft Graph API endpoints explored via graph_listOperations during the current MCP session. Used by the OperationSelection topic to skip the endpoint Question node when the AI has already researched endpoints. Returns an empty list if no session context is found.

parameters.name: userObjectId
parameters.description: AAD Object ID of the calling user. Used for session context lookup when no Authorization header is present (NoAuth connectors). Pass System.User.AadObjectId from Copilot Studio.

200.description: Endpoints explored in the current session.

endpointPath.description: Comma-separated endpoint paths. When multiple endpoints were explored, contains all of them (e.g. '/users,/groups'). When single, contains just that endpoint.

get.description: Returns the full session context including explored endpoints and design decisions captured via graph_setDesignContext. Flat response: all endpoint tracking fields plus all design context fields merged at top level. Used by the OperationSelection topic to pre-fill connector configuration (auth type, base name, environment, connector grouping, etc.).

parameters.name: userObjectId
parameters.description: AAD Object ID of the calling user. Used for session context lookup when no Authorization header is present (NoAuth connectors). Pass System.User.AadObjectId from Copilot Studio.

200.description: Full session context including endpoint tracking and design decisions.

endpointPath.description: Comma-separated endpoint paths from design context. When multiple endpoints were explored, contains all of them (e.g. '/users,/groups'). When single, contains just that endpoint.

hasDesignContext.description: True if graph_setDesignContext was called during this session.

authType.description: Desired auth type: NoAuth, OAuthAAD, or FederatedIdentity.

maxOperations.description: Maximum operations allowed per connector (from server config). Used for card-side cap enforcement.

baseName.description: Connector base name — either AI-provided or auto-generated from endpoints. Check baseNameSource to determine origin.

baseNameSource.description: 'ai' = name provided by the AI during research, 'generated' = auto-generated from endpoint paths. When 'generated', the user should be prompted to confirm or edit.

targetVersion.description: Target Graph API version: v1.0 or beta.

connectorGroupsJson.description: Deprecated — kept for backward compatibility. Always empty string. Use group1Json, group2Json, group3Json instead.

group1Json.description: JSON-serialized connector group 1 object with baseName and operations array. Empty string if fewer than 1 group.

group2Json.description: JSON-serialized connector group 2 object with baseName and operations array. Empty string if fewer than 2 groups.

group3Json.description: JSON-serialized connector group 3 object with baseName and operations array. Empty string if fewer than 3 groups.

post.description: Generate Power Platform custom connector Swagger files for multiple connector groups in a single call. Accepts a JSON string of groups (each with baseName and ops), generates each connector, publishes to Gist, and returns results as a JSON string for Parse value node consumption.

groupsJson.description: JSON string containing an array of connector groups. Each group has baseName (string) and ops (comma-separated operation IDs string). Example: [{"baseName":"Users","ops":"users.list,users.get"},{"baseName":"Groups","ops":"groups.list"}]

successCount.description: Number of groups that generated successfully

resultsJson.description: JSON string containing per-group results array. Each item has baseName, gistUrl, swaggerRawUrl, totalOperations, status, warnings, and optional error. Use Parse value node with sample JSON to convert to typed Table.

post.description: Sprint 15 M1 test endpoint. Accepts groupsJson string, parses it, and echoes back the parsed groups plus a sample batch response.

groupsJson.description: JSON string containing an array of connector groups. Each group has baseName and ops (comma-separated operation IDs).

200.description: Echo of parsed batch parameters plus sample results

encodingUsed.description: Which encoding was used: groupsJson, individual, or none

parseError.description: JSON parse error message, if any

resultsJson.description: JSON string containing sample batch results array. Use Parse value node with sample JSON to convert to typed Table.
